findings.location: Definition: regular-patch assertion after the rank condition and identification of flux with a regular patch
findings.evidence: The opened regular-patch definition requires connected parameter interior and no interior image identifications. Neither follows from the moving-patch hypotheses. Disconnected rectangles violate connectedness; the stationary map r(u,w)=(exp(u)cos(w),exp(u)sin(w),0) on [0,1]x[0,4pi] has rank two but overlapping interior images. The producer subsequently distinguished parametrized multiplicity from admissible regular patches. This finding records the pre-source claim.
